name: qwen3.8-27b-dflash2-drafter
notes: DFlash2 block-diffusion draft model for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B (z-lab/Inco AI). NOT a served model — transfer profile only, used to mirror the drafter to R2 for speculative decoding (--speculative-config method=dflash). 1.92B params BF16, single ~3.9 GB safetensors. Shares the target's embeddings/lm_head; target lm_head must be bf16. Pairs with the vllm#52816 DFlash2 backport on vLLM v0.27.1.
